patch_list: Restores the original certificate SHA-1 so Firebase Auth (Google login) and push notifications keep working after the APK is re-signed.
Rewrites the cached user model to Premium level (4020). Unlocks client-side VIP features and hides ads. Requires a fresh install.
Hides the 'Deals' tab and campaign ads by forcing the local preference flags to true.
